rationale: Development-derived simplification after OPTIONAL/SEARCH failed. Mean-based CAL and GLOBAL components already scored; this is not an independent confirmation. Shared fixed converged FINAL replaces mean on both sides, no per-domain GT-best checkpoint.
primary_rule: Task-provided PRESUPPOSED: exact ordinary FINAL identity. Task-provided CHECKLIST: frozen equal-total-edge GLOBAL pooling. Both then same frozen visual PAVA. Never branch on dataset or target presence labels.

ordinary_baselines.shared_head: Exact confidence-weighted 768D direct converged FINAL, source logit zero; same COVER answers; min4000/max16000 teacher-KL convergence
ordinary_baselines.protocol_control: Independent Bernoulli candidate marginals condition on >=1 for PRESUPPOSED, CHECKLIST unchanged; assumes fixed candidate coverage, not a GT oracle
ordinary_baselines.preserved: Weighted mean/400/final/hard400/hard-final plus all previous native/RGB/SEM ordinary heads

frozen_global: Same .1 source precision, raw known-answer anchor, confidence weights, and complete graph total edge weight as existing operator; rank-one solve must match dense probabilities <=1e-12 and decisions exactly

scientific_gate.primary: Both directions vs shared FINAL and BASE_PROTOCOL: all3 seed deltas positive and parent+seed CI strictly positive; report whole strong ordinary family including mean
scientific_gate.modules: PAVA incremental effect vs PROTOCOL_GRAPH: positive parent+seed CI in at least one direction; CHECKLIST scene pooling vs FINAL_CAL positive CI. Do not require every mechanism every domain, no universal ranking claim.
scientific_gate.protocol: Report always-local/global/identity controls; bad-control gap alone cannot show improvement beyond strong ordinary baseline
scientific_gate.ranking: Report both CountMatched projections. Quantity-driven benefit cannot be called pure semantic ranking.
scientific_gate.cost: Only if quality gates pass, matched fresh 4 arms, exact shared FINAL readout; existing mean-based cold times cannot be reused

adaptation_inputs: Target images, task queries, official frozen boxes/TrackIDs, frozen teacher; no target manual labels. GT only isolated evaluation after seals.
temporal_contract: Current video transductive and past/current video teacher prefix; no future video answers; not frame online
